project_type: Cost-minimized serverless AWS quiz app. AWS CDK v2 backend + React 18 / Vite 5 / TypeScript multi-page frontend.
build_system: npm + AWS CDK v2 (backend); npm + Vite 5 multi-page (frontend). Deps are EXACTLY react + react-dom; keep it that way, no lockfile changes.
test_framework: Jest with ts-jest over synthesized CloudFormation template (test/quiz-app-stack.test.ts). Frontend has NO test runner.
build_command: Backend: npx cdk synth. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build.
verification_instructions: In sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) npm registry is 403 so tsc/jest/cdk synth/vite build CANNOT run. Author correct-by-construction and verify by reading. Confirm the exact redirect_uri strings produced by auth.ts match byte-for-byte the callbackUrls/logoutUrls registered in lib/quiz-app-stack.ts (scheme, host, path, trailing slash). Document the user's real verification/deploy commands in README.
setup_instructions: Backend: npm install at repo root. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: npm install / tsc / jest / cdk synth / vite build cannot run in the sandbox (npm registry returns 403). No build/test verification possible here; rely on careful reading. Do NOT push or open a PR.
contribution_requirements: Keep frontend deps exactly react + react-dom, no lockfile. Do NOT change JWT authorizer, WebSocket API, scoring, or anything unrelated. Strictly the OAuth redirect URL matching.
key_patterns: auth.ts builds Hosted UI login/logout URLs; redirect_uri currently derived from adminPageUrl() = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname. AdminPage.tsx (served at /admin.html) and BattlePage.tsx (public app served at ROOT / by Amplify, NOT /index.html) both call the SAME loginUrl()/logoutUrl(). CDK registers callbackUrls/logoutUrls as `${adminAppBaseUrl}/admin.html` and `${adminAppBaseUrl}/index.html` plus localhost variants gated by includeLocalhostCallback context flag.
directory_structure: lib/ = CDK stack; lambda/ = handlers; test/ = jest CDK tests; frontend/ = Vite multi-page SPA (index.html at root, admin.html at /admin.html); frontend/src/pages/ = AdminPage.tsx & BattlePage.tsx; README.md = setup/deploy docs.
root_cause: redirect_mismatch: the battle host lives in the public app which Amplify serves at the ROOT URL (window.location.pathname = '/'), so loginUrl() sends redirect_uri = origin + '/', but Cognito only trusts origin + '/index.html' and origin + '/admin.html'. Cognito requires an EXACT match, so it rejects '/'. Adding '/index.html' to the callback list does not help because the browser is at '/', not '/index.html'.
chosen_fix: Option (a): canonicalize the public-app host redirect to the ROOT. auth.ts gets an explicit-redirect capability: admin page passes origin + '/admin.html'; battle host passes origin + '/' (canonical root, matching how Amplify serves the site). CDK registers `${adminAppBaseUrl}/admin.html` and `${adminAppBaseUrl}/` (dropping the never-matched '/index.html' and its localhost twin, keeping '/admin.html'), plus the corresponding localhost variants under includeLocalhostCallback. Both sides must match byte-for-byte; code comments on both sides call this out. captureTokenFromHash's history.replaceState may keep deriving its target from the live location (origin + pathname) since only the redirect_uri sent to Cognito must be the registered canonical string.
